title: Rotgut's Drool Covered Microphone
description: Rotgut's Drool Covered Microphone — The Townstons wiki
html:
Rotgut's Drool Covered Microphone
Client type:  1H Mace
Class palette:  Fighter
Quality:  Mythic (rainbow)

Rotgut's Drool Covered Microphone is a named mythic item from the client file items/pal/1HMacePAL.gc (MythicPreBuiltBoss001).

This is the base name. Rolled mythics can also append a suffix from Mythic Suffixes. Those endings change the last part of the name and add the bonus listed on that page. This page does not invent extra roll combinations.

The template sets SoulBound = true. This microphone is covered with drool! It not only messes up the sound of your voice potentially Butchering the song, but your opponent as well.

Fixed mods on this template (client LabelType = NONE, always on the item):

  • END
  • +Divine, +Melee damage
  • Stun
  • Max health
  • Butcher proc
